notes: Piece list totals 140 pieces; ids b1..b140 assigned in build order and every listed piece appears once.

The manual has no text, so which exact studs each piece sits on is judged from the isometric pictures. Ports are left null throughout except for axle/hinge joints, and several joins (especially the layered face pieces in steps 12-18 and 30-40) are best-effort.
Step 15 shows plain black 1x2 tiles (3069b), and step 39 shows the grille tiles (2412b). I assigned them on that basis.

Step 21 onwards: the model is flipped and the white backing frame (1x16 bricks, 1x10 brick, 1x10 plates) is built on the back of the four 4x12 plates. The stand (axles, elbows, hinge cylinders) is hinged to the hinge plates b76/b77. Step 41 hinges the nose dome via the 1x2 hinge brick top (b140) onto the hinge base (b118).

Step 29 builds the bow sub-assembly (red round plate, tan plates, red quarter tiles) on top of the red round plate b36. Steps 34 and 36 repeat sub-assemblies twice. They are written out explicitly rather than as repeats, because the copies attach to different parts.
Step 38 shows 1x1 white plates in the parts box but not in the arrow sub-assembly. I assumed they carry the quarter tiles on the 2x6 round-corner plate.
